 PETALING JAYA: Taman Sri Muda in Shah Alam is among several areas hit by flash floods in Selangor but no evacuations have taken place.
 Selangor Fire and Rescue Department operations division assistant director Ashrul Riezal Asbar, when contacted, said no evacuation orders have been issued and firefighters were on standby.
 He added that water levels were rising in Seksyen 25 Sri Muda, Kampung Baru Hicom and Seksyen 26.
 He said areas at risk of flooding include Jalan Kebun, Seksyen 13, and Jalan Kebun Bunga, Seksyen 22.
 "Firefighters are currently monitoring areas along hotspots. No evacuations have been conducted yet," he said on Sunday (Nov 8).
 Taman Sri Muda is a flood-prone area and was badly hit in the December 2021 floods, which recorded at least 14 deaths.
